summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by wiring FLUME VAE encoding, EVO lifecycle tracking, SurrealDB persistence, Mycelium skill synthesis, and Ouroboros anomaly detection into a closed feedback loop; then scale to an overnight autoresearch runner and build a broader compound engineering analytics subsystem.
summary.outcome: Delivered a complete EVO research pipeline (E1-E62), an additive Mycelium calibration fix (E57), a 10-module compound analytics subsystem, and fixed 100+ test failures across FLUME, compound, universe, patterns, cache, and hookify test suites; overnight loop accumulated 200K+ SurrealDB journey_point records with reproducible E63 delta=+0.0625 and E63_lr2 delta=+0.1250.

repo: autoresearch.jsonl stores the experiment label at r['asi']['experiment'] (nested), not r['experiment'] at top level; status is 'keep'/'discard' at r['status'], metric at r['metric']
The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically carries forward uncommitted changes to orphan branches and resets the working tree; workaround is git checkout HEAD -- <file> or git stash before commit

run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally overwrites _score_adjustments on every deliberation call — the two-layer model keeps _mycelium_calibration as the stable cross-cycle store and _score_adjustments as the per-call surface

SurrealDB HTTP probe requires 'RETURN true;' not 'SELECT 1;'; journey_point table is in cohezion/main namespace; timestamp fields require time::now() not ISO string literals; metadata subfields on SCHEMAFULL tables require 'result' (option<string>) as a JSON-packed escape hatch
OllamaEmbeddingProvider was removed from cohezion.flume; tests that patched it must be updated to use fallback_to_hash=True instead

vault_find_relevant_context is async; any synchronous caller (skill_selector.py, vault.py) must use vault_search() sync wrapper or _fire_vault_write() pattern to avoid unawaited-coroutine RuntimeWarnings
FlumeVAE.forward() returns 4 values: (recon/logits, mu, log_var, z); callers that unpacked 3 values broke when z was added back to the tuple
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var bypasses the Kaggle branch guard pre-commit hook for files in competition directories
BioelectricNetwork uses percolation_analysis(threshold=...) not percolate(); PercolationResult exposes largest_cluster_size not giant_component_fraction

HookifyValidator.set_lever_position() requires the rule to already exist in the registry — override store must be pre-loaded; SurrealDB persistence failures in MCP bridge should be silenced (best-effort) not propagated

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback() had SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) causing cycle-2 decay; E57 fix changes to += into _mycelium_calibration, then exposes via _score_adjustments; oscillation detection via _detect_oscillation() halves lr when last 3 adjustments alternate sign
Called self.mcp_client.vault_find_relevant_context(...) synchronously — async method without await creates unawaited coroutine; fixed to use self.mcp_client.vault_search() sync wrapper

All self.mcp.vault_write(), vault_delete(), vault_read() calls were sync-calling async methods; fixed to vault_write_sync(), vault_delete_sync(), vault_read_sync() wrappers that use loop detection pattern

forward() now returns 4 values (recon, mu, log_var, z); added legacy MLP mode via FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256); reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode; flume_vae_loss() is now a standalone function supporting MSE/CE + KL + HIHO coherence penalty
ExecutionResult dataclass was missing compound_score field; added compound_score: float = 0.0 computed from 0.6*coherence + 0.3*success + 0.1*efficiency

_call_tool() now re-raises MCPToolError directly to prevent double-wrapping; error dict extraction handles both {error: {message:...}} and {error: 'string'} formats; connect() raises MCPAuthenticationError for 401/403 distinct from MCPConnectionError

UCB1 sorting was ranking untested transforms (trials=0 → UCB1=∞) above confirmed-best transforms, causing beam_search to return empty chain; fix tracks actual_best by score before UCB1 sorting so the best candidate is never excluded from beam

direction-aware comparison was missing: minimize metrics (e.g. loss) were marked regression when lower (better); fixed to check self.direction == 'minimize'; _update_tree() now accepts both string and ExperimentOutcome

analyze_cache_effectiveness() flip-flopped between async/sync during session; final state is async to satisfy test_cache_warmer.py async def tests; test_cache_warmer_integration.py uses asyncio.run() wrapper

psutil mock must cover BOTH virtual_memory AND cpu_percent (not just memory); system at 99.4% CPU from background agents causes resource guardrail to block all execute_task calls, producing cascading state-leakage test failures

New unified CompoundEngine entry point integrating SessionMetricsAggregator, CompoundScoreWindow, ExperimentScheduler; recommend_next_experiments() and get_health() convenience methods; render_dashboard() on SessionMetricsAggregator provides ASCII HIHO bar + experiment table

workflow: AsyncMock (Python 3.8+) is required when mocking any awaitable method; patching httpx.Client instead of httpx.AsyncClient means the mock is never invoked and assert_called_once() always fails
asyncio.run() is the correct bridge for sync unittest.TestCase methods calling async production code; async def test_* works with pytest-asyncio but not with plain unittest.TestCase
Surgical git add <specific files> + KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 is the reliable pre-commit playbook; ruff format + ruff check --fix before staging prevents the 'ruff-quick failed to fix' loop
For LFS pointer/content mismatch (runtime log file tracked by LFS): git rm --cached <file> + echo >> .gitignore is the permanent fix; temporary workaround is git stash push --keep-index before commit
git stash push --keep-index conflicts with pre-commit when the stash phase uses git checkout -- . that conflicts with LFS-tracked files; moving the file to /tmp before stash avoids the conflict
V-model structural invariants using inspect.signature() are ~1ms each and catch API drift before behavioral tests; they should be the first tests in any executor test file

When a pre-commit hook auto-fixes a staged file (e.g. ruff removes an unused import), the commit fails because the staged version differs from the working-tree version; solution is to run ruff manually, re-stage, then commit

friction: Entire.io checkpoint daemon repeatedly reverted working-tree edits to orphan branches, requiring git checkout HEAD -- <file> restoration multiple times per session

autoresearch.jsonl LFS pointer/content mismatch blocked every commit until the file was untracked; pre-commit's stash/restore phase raised 'File exists' fatal error when trying to restore the LFS pointer
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack entered silent failure mode mid-session — all evaluation prompts returned empty strings; required heuristic fallback, losing all LLM-score variance in experiments

The two-layer _mycelium_calibration/_score_adjustments model was repeatedly misunderstood: run_llm_deliberation SETs _score_adjustments on every call, so E47 had to modify _mycelium_calibration instead — this caused multiple failed experiments before the root cause was identified
SIGSEGV in test_flume_cli and test_cli_train tests from GPU stack (HIP kernel compile error) — entirely hardware-specific and unresolvable in code

Gemini worktree was silently cleaned up mid-session, destroying 3500 lines of new experiment code (E55-E62 overnight loop implementation) that hadn't been committed; had to be reconstructed from memory
Pre-commit hook ran ruff --fix on staged files during the stash phase, modifying staged content and causing 'cannot commit because staged file differs from working-tree' cycle
log_result() has 6 positional args with no type enforcement; E71-E76 experiments all used wrong arg order (missing 'run' and 'status'), only caught during import smoke test
open_items: test_resource_adversarial::test_adversarial_flood StopIteration deep in BaseAgent async mock (StopIteration→RuntimeError in async generator) — not fixed
apply_mycelium_feedback() has no callers in src/ production code; the E57 fix is tested but the feedback loop is only exercised via experiment scripts, not wired into CompoundExecutor
SurrealDB experiment_runs table has 0 records — the HTTP-direct write code was only in the Gemini worktree which was cleaned up; experiment results only land in autoresearch.jsonl
E73 oscillation detection in overnight_evo_loop.py calls nexus._mycelium_calibration_history which may not be initialized if the nexus is fresh per-experiment (reset_shared_nexus clears it)
Lemonade iGPU ROCm recovery: when the stack recovers, all LLM experiments need re-run with real variance; E63 delta=+0.0625 is heuristic-only, LLM-mode delta will differ
autoresearch.jsonl was removed from git tracking (.gitignore) but the overnight loop still writes to it; cross-session analytics via load_experiment_records() will lose older records on next clone
ExperimentScheduler is not wired into overnight_evo_loop.py main loop; retirement detection only runs in the analytics CLI, not automatically during the loop
FlumeVAE legacy MLP mode added for backward-compat test support but the two modes share __init__ with branching logic that will grow complex as features are added to one mode only
